answer: The nadir holds work receipts rather than names, so the ivory of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, held in escrow until finality, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the harbor of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
